general.description: A large frozen hunk of ice and regolith with an ad-hoc station dug out into the crust from abandoned ships and opportunistically recycled materials, and with life-support seeming like more of an afterthought. Although barely visible from afar, the sprawling complex covers a large swathe of the planet with intricate tunnels and rooms dug deep in the surface. Naturally, rumours of all sorts of incredible riches hidden throughout abound, and it is no uncommon to hear of the horrible demise of scavengers freezing to death or getting crushed by unstable constructions in their search. Of course, those could also just be rumours discouraging people to find said incredible riches.
general.bar: As part of the marketing strategy, the Lonely Star bar uses no direct heating to keep clients warm, instead, encouraging the consumption of hot drinks. While this may seem like a questionable business decision, the low temperature also minimizes the fistfights with visiting House Dvaered soldiers, something very appreciated by the locals, such that complaints are kept at a minimum.
